issue_title: [Security] Race condition window between file size check and JSON load (TOCTOU)
fix_summary: Fixed TOCTOU race condition by reading file once into memory, then checking buffer size instead of using separate stat() and read_text() operations.

implementation_approach.description: Changed TodoStorage.load() to read file content once into memory using read_text(), then check the buffer size using len(content.encode('utf-8')), instead of calling stat() for size check followed by read_text() for content. This eliminates the race condition window between size check and read.
implementation_approach.security_impact: Eliminates TOCTOU (Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use) vulnerability where an attacker with write access could replace the file after size check but before read.
acceptance_criteria_met: File is read only once, then size check is performed on in-memory buffer

risks_limitations: Small performance impact: content is encoded to bytes to check size (minimal for typical todo files)
File is fully read into memory before size check, but this is mitigated by the existing 10MB limit
